---
title: "12 · Manuscript tables (charts to be added)"
output: html_notebook
---

Reads the final csv files written by notebooks 03-11 and builds every manuscript table.
Each table is shown below and all tables are written to one Word file:
`output/tables/manuscript_tables.docx` (one table per page; wide tables in landscape).
Nothing is re-estimated here.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(here); library(tidyverse); library(flextable); library(officer)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

sfx <- "_v2"                                  # suffix of the final csv files; change if you renamed them
rd  <- \(f) read_csv(here("output", "tables", paste0(f, sfx, ".csv")), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Labels and formatting helpers
```{r helpers}
lab <- c(
  # outcomes
  off_vers = "Versatility (number of offence types)", prop_any = "Property offending",
  viol_any = "Violent offending", oth_any = "Other offending", serious_any = "Serious offending",
  download_any = "Illegal downloading",
  # procedural justice
  LEG = "Legitimacy", PJ = "Procedural fairness", PJ_EQUAL = "Police treat all groups equally",
  EFF = "Perceived police effectiveness",
  # institutional anomie
  NTS_wth = "Norm transmission, within class", NTS_cls = "Norm transmission, class mean",
  NTS_prof_inst = "Norm transmission (student score)", NTS_prof_inst_cls = "Norm transmission (class mean)",
  # situational action
  MOR = "Morality", SHAME_shop = "Shame: shoplifting", SHAME_hurt = "Shame: hurting someone",
  SC = "Self-control", `MOR:SC` = "Morality × self-control",
  # controls
  male = "Male", deprfam = "Family deprivation", SCHB = "School bond", PEERD = "Delinquent peers",
  # sensitivity-only terms
  SHAME_arrest = "Shame: being arrested", SC_imp = "Self-control: impulsivity (reversed)",
  SC_risk = "Self-control: risk-taking (reversed)", SC_self = "Self-control: self-centredness (reversed)",
  over_age = "Over age for grade 9", SN_prof_cm = "Classmates' norms", SN_prof_pe = "Neighbourhood peers' norms",
  NORM_inst = "Norm part (parents and teacher)", BOND_inst = "Bond part (parents and teacher)",
  `NORM_inst:BOND_inst` = "Norm × bond", MOR7 = "Morality (seven items, without downloading)",
  z_prosoc4 = "Morality: illegal downloading item", `NTS_cls:g9` = "Norm transmission, class mean × grade 9")
labv <- \(x) unname(coalesce(lab[x], x))

fmt <- \(x, d = 2) ifelse(is.na(x), "", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d))
fp  <- \(p) case_when(is.na(p) ~ "", p < .001 ~ "<.001",
                      TRUE ~ sub("^(-?)0\\.", "\\1.", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)))
ci  <- \(r, lo, hi, d = 2) ifelse(is.na(r), "", paste0(fmt(r, d), " [", fmt(lo, d), ", ", fmt(hi, d), "]"))
pct <- \(x) fmt(x, 1)

b_thick <- fp_border(color = "black", width = 1)
b_thin  <- fp_border(color = "black", width = .75)

# APA-style table: title above, rule under the title, rule under the header, rule at the end, note below
apa <- function(ft, title, note = NULL, panel_rows = NULL, width = 6.5, left = 1) {
  ft <- ft |>
    font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "all") |> fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") |>
    border_remove() |>
    hline_top(part = "header", border = b_thick) |>
    hline_bottom(part = "header", border = b_thin) |>
    hline_bottom(part = "body", border = b_thick) |>
    align(align = "center", part = "all") |> align(j = left, align = "left", part = "all") |>
    valign(valign = "bottom", part = "header") |> padding(padding = 1, part = "all")
  if (!is.null(panel_rows)) ft <- ft |> bold(i = panel_rows, part = "body") |> italic(i = panel_rows, part = "body") |>
      merge_h_range(i = panel_rows, j1 = 1, j2 = ncol_keys(ft), part = "body") |>
      align(i = panel_rows, align = "left", part = "body")
  if (!is.null(note)) ft <- ft |> add_footer_lines(paste("Note.", note)) |> fontsize(size = 9, part = "footer") |>
      font(fontname = "Times New Roman", part = "footer") |> align(align = "left", part = "footer")
  # column widths: fit to content; if too wide, narrow the widest (text) column so its text wraps
  ft <- autofit(ft, add_w = 0.1, part = "body")       # headers wrap
  w  <- dim(ft)$widths
  if (sum(w) > width) {
    k <- which.max(w); w[k] <- max(1.5, width - sum(w[-k]))
    if (sum(w) > width) w <- w * width / sum(w)
    ft <- width(ft, width = w)
  }
  # title added last so that it does not affect the column widths
  ft |> add_header_lines(title) |> bold(i = 1, part = "header") |> align(i = 1, align = "left", part = "header") |>
    fontsize(i = 1, size = 10, part = "header")
}

# insert a bold panel label row before each group; returns the data and the row numbers of the labels
with_panels <- function(df, group_col) {
  g <- df[[group_col]]; df[[group_col]] <- NULL
  out <- map_dfr(unique(g), \(x) bind_rows(
    tibble(!!names(df)[1] := x) |> mutate(across(everything(), as.character)),
    df[g == x, ] |> mutate(across(everything(), as.character))))
  out[is.na(out)] <- ""
  list(df = out, rows = which(out[[1]] %in% unique(g)))
}

tabs <- list()       # every table goes here: list(ft = , landscape = )
add_tab <- function(name, ft, landscape = FALSE) tabs[[name]] <<- list(ft = ft, landscape = landscape)
```

## Read the result files
```{r read}
var_sum <- rd("var_summary"); prev <- rd("prevalence_by_sex"); icc <- rd("icc"); rel <- rd("reliability")
rq1     <- rd("rq1_coef");    blocks <- rd("rq1_blocks"); n1 <- rd("rq1_n")
khb     <- rd("khb");         khb_c  <- rd("sensitivity_khb_components")
t_slope <- rd("rq2_type_slopes"); t_diff <- rd("rq2_type_diff"); sep <- rd("rq2_separate")
dl      <- rd("rq2_download");    loco   <- rd("rq2_loco")
g_int   <- rd("rq2_gender_int");  g_ame  <- rd("rq2_gender_ame")
leg     <- rd("rq3_legitimacy");  h3     <- rd("rq3_h3"); ind <- rd("rq3_indirect")
sens    <- rd("sensitivity");     ev     <- rd("sensitivity_evalues"); h1g <- rd("sensitivity_h1_grade")

theory_of <- \(t) case_when(t %in% c("LEG","PJ","PJ_EQUAL","EFF") ~ "Procedural justice",
                            t %in% c("NTS_wth","NTS_cls") ~ "Institutional anomie",
                            t %in% c("MOR","SHAME_shop","SHAME_hurt","SC","MOR:SC") ~ "Situational action",
                            t %in% c("male","deprfam","SCHB","PEERD") ~ "Controls", TRUE ~ NA_character_)
theory_levels <- c("Procedural justice", "Institutional anomie", "Situational action", "Controls")
term_order <- c("LEG","PJ","PJ_EQUAL","EFF","NTS_wth","NTS_cls","MOR","SHAME_shop","SHAME_hurt","SC","MOR:SC",
                "male","deprfam","SCHB","PEERD")
```

## Appendix Table A9. Measures
Item descriptions are short summaries; check them against the questionnaire wording.
```{r t1}
rel_all <- rel |> filter(group == "all")
t1_raw <- tribble(
  ~theory, ~var, ~description, ~rel_name,
  "Outcomes", "off_vers", "Number of 13 offence types committed in the last year (*lyp items)", NA,
  "Outcomes", "prop_any", "Any of: shoplifting, burglary, bicycle theft, car theft, theft from a car, theft from a person (shop, burg, bict, cart, carb, thef)", NA,
  "Outcomes", "viol_any", "Any of: robbery, carrying a weapon, group fight, assault (exto, weap, gfig, aslt)", NA,
  "Outcomes", "oth_any", "Any of: graffiti, vandalism, drug selling (graf, vand, drud)", NA,
  "Outcomes", "serious_any", "Any of: burglary, car theft, robbery, assault, carrying a weapon, drug selling", NA,
  "Outcomes", "download_any", "Illegal downloading in the last year (downlyp)", NA,
  "Procedural justice", "LEG", "Duty to obey (pjduty), moral alignment (pjattri1-3), lawfulness: bribes reversed (pjbribes); items standardised. Full wording of all items in Table A1", "LEG",
  "Procedural justice", "PJ", "Police treat people with respect, make fair decisions, explain decisions (pjresp, pjfair, pjexpl)", "PJ",
  "Procedural justice", "PJ_EQUAL", "Police treat all groups equally (pjdiscr; 1 = equally)", NA,
  "Procedural justice", "EFF", "How quickly the police would arrive at the scene (pjspeed)", NA,
  "Institutional anomie", "NTS_prof_inst", "Expected reaction of parents and teacher to selling a phone at a high price by hiding a cheaper model (profsnmo, profsnfa, profsnte), each weighted by bond to that person (fambond1-4, teabond1-2); split into class mean and within-class deviation", "FAMB",
  "Situational action", "MOR", "How wrong it is to do eight acts (prosoc1-8)", "MOR",
  "Situational action", "SHAME_shop", "Shame if parents, teacher, friends found out about shoplifting (shampar1, shamtea1, shamfrd1)", "SHAME_shop",
  "Situational action", "SHAME_hurt", "Shame if parents, teacher, friends found out about hurting someone (shampar2, shamtea2, shamfrd2)", "SHAME_hurt",
  "Situational action", "SC", "Nine items: impulsivity, risk-taking, self-centredness (selfc01-09); POMP score", "SC",
  "Controls", "male", "Sex (1 = male)", NA,
  "Controls", "deprfam", "Family deprivation (deprfam)", NA,
  "Controls", "SCHB", "School bond (schbond1-4)", "SCHB",
  "Controls", "PEERD", "Number of five delinquent acts committed by friends (delpdr, delpsl, delpbu, delpex, delpas)", NA,
  "Controls", "region", "District socio-economic level, four groups (cityid)", NA,
  "Controls", "schtype", "School type: general, imam hatip, vocational (schtypeid)", NA)

t1 <- t1_raw |>
  left_join(rel_all |> select(rel_name = scale, k, alpha_std, omega), by = "rel_name") |>
  left_join(var_sum |> select(var = variable, min, max), by = "var") |>
  transmute(theory, Measure = labv(var), Description = description,
            Range = ifelse(is.na(min), "", paste0(fmt(min), "–", fmt(max))),
            k = ifelse(is.na(k), "", as.character(k)), alpha = fmt(alpha_std), omega = fmt(omega)) |>
  mutate(Measure = recode(Measure, region = "District socio-economic level", schtype = "School type"))
p1 <- with_panels(t1, "theory")
ft1 <- flextable(p1$df) |>
  set_header_labels(alpha = "α", omega = "ω") |>
  apa("Table A9. Measures", panel_rows = p1$rows, width = 9, left = 1:2,
      note = paste("Range is the observed range before standardisation. α = standardised Cronbach's alpha;",
                   "ω = omega total. For norm transmission, α and ω refer to the family bond items.",
                   "All continuous predictors are standardised (z-scores) in the models."))
add_tab("t1", ft1, landscape = TRUE); ft1
```

## Table 1. Descriptive statistics
```{r t2}
icc_v  <- \(v) { x <- icc$icc[match(v, icc$variable)]; fmt(x) }
girls  <- prev |> filter(sex == "girls"); boys <- prev |> filter(sex == "boys")
bin_y  <- c("prop_any", "viol_any", "oth_any", "serious_any", "download_any")

t2a <- bind_rows(
  tibble(Variable = labv("off_vers"),
         All   = paste0(fmt(var_sum$mean[var_sum$variable == "off_vers"]), " (",
                        fmt(var_sum$sd[var_sum$variable == "off_vers"]), ")"),
         Girls = "", Boys = "",
         `% missing` = pct(var_sum$pct_missing[var_sum$variable == "off_vers"]), ICC = icc_v("off_vers")),
  map_dfr(bin_y, \(y) tibble(
    Variable = labv(y),
    All   = pct(100 * var_sum$mean[var_sum$variable == y]),
    Girls = paste0(pct(girls[[paste0(y, "_pct")]]), " (", girls[[paste0(y, "_n")]], ")"),
    Boys  = paste0(pct(boys[[paste0(y, "_pct")]]),  " (", boys[[paste0(y, "_n")]],  ")"),
    `% missing` = pct(var_sum$pct_missing[var_sum$variable == y]), ICC = icc_v(y))))
ft2a <- flextable(t2a) |>
  set_header_labels(All = "All", Girls = paste0("Girls (n = ", girls$n, ")"), Boys = paste0("Boys (n = ", boys$n, ")")) |>
  apa("Table 1. Descriptive statistics. Panel A: Offending in the last year",
      note = paste("Versatility: mean (SD). Other rows: % (number of students).",
                   "ICC = intra-class correlation for classes (latent scale for binary outcomes)."))

pred_v <- c("LEG","PJ","PJ_EQUAL","EFF","NTS_prof_inst","NTS_prof_inst_cls","MOR","SHAME_shop","SHAME_hurt","SC",
            "male","deprfam","SCHB","PEERD")
icc_nts <- if ("NTS_prof_inst" %in% icc$variable) "NTS_prof_inst" else "NTS_prof"
t2b <- var_sum |> filter(variable %in% pred_v) |>
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = pred_v)) |> arrange(variable) |>
  transmute(Variable = labv(as.character(variable)),
            `M or %` = ifelse(variable %in% c("PJ_EQUAL", "male"), pct(100 * mean), fmt(mean)),
            SD = ifelse(variable %in% c("PJ_EQUAL", "male"), "", fmt(sd)),
            Range = paste0(fmt(min), "–", fmt(max)), `% missing` = pct(pct_missing),
            ICC = case_when(variable == "NTS_prof_inst" ~ icc_v(icc_nts),
                            variable == "NTS_prof_inst_cls" ~ "",
                            TRUE ~ icc_v(as.character(variable))),
            alpha = fmt(rel_all$alpha_std[match(as.character(variable), rel_all$scale)]))
ft2b <- flextable(t2b) |>
  set_header_labels(alpha = "α") |>
  apa("Table 1 (continued). Panel B: Predictors and controls",
      note = paste("Values before standardisation. Binary variables are shown as %. α = standardised Cronbach's alpha.",
                   if (icc_nts == "NTS_prof") "ICC for norm transmission refers to the three-informant measure." else ""))
add_tab("t2a", ft2a); add_tab("t2b", ft2b); ft2a; ft2b
```

## Table 2. Contribution of each theory (pooled likelihood-ratio tests)
```{r t3}
blk_lab <- c(PJT = "Procedural justice", IAT = "Institutional anomie", SAT = "Situational action",
             `MOR x SC` = "Morality × self-control")
t3 <- blocks |>
  mutate(cell_D2 = fmt(D2), cell_p = fp(p), cell_aic = fmt(dAIC, 1),
         type = ifelse(type == "H5", "unique", type)) |>
  select(outcome, block, type, df, cell_D2, cell_p, cell_aic) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = c(cell_D2, cell_p, cell_aic)) |>
  mutate(block = factor(block, levels = names(blk_lab))) |>
  arrange(outcome, block) |> mutate(outcome = labv(outcome)) |>
  transmute(outcome, Block = blk_lab[as.character(block)], df = as.character(df),
            T_D2 = cell_D2_total, T_p = cell_p_total, T_aic = cell_aic_total,
            U_D2 = cell_D2_unique, U_p = cell_p_unique, U_aic = cell_aic_unique)
t3[is.na(t3)] <- ""
p3 <- with_panels(t3, "outcome")
ft3 <- flextable(p3$df) |>
  set_header_labels(T_D2 = "D2", T_p = "p", T_aic = "ΔAIC", U_D2 = "D2", U_p = "p", U_aic = "ΔAIC") |>
  add_header_row(values = c("", "", "Total contribution", "Unique contribution"), colwidths = c(1, 1, 3, 3)) |>
  apa("Table 2. Contribution of each theory's measures to the models of offending", panel_rows = p3$rows,
      note = paste("Total contribution: the theory's measures added to the controls only.",
                   "Unique contribution: the theory's measures added to a model with the other two theories.",
                   "Morality × self-control: the interaction added to the full model.",
                   "D2 = pooled likelihood-ratio statistic over 50 imputations; ΔAIC = mean change in AIC (negative = better fit).",
                   "Versatility: negative binomial; serious offending: logistic; random intercept for class."))
add_tab("t3", ft3); ft3
```

## Appendix Table A10. Coefficients of the theory measures
```{r t4}
alone <- rq1 |> filter(model %in% c("ctrl_PJT", "ctrl_IAT", "ctrl_SAT"),
                       (model == "ctrl_PJT" & term %in% c("LEG","PJ","PJ_EQUAL","EFF")) |
                       (model == "ctrl_IAT" & term %in% c("NTS_wth","NTS_cls")) |
                       (model == "ctrl_SAT" & term %in% c("MOR","SHAME_shop","SHAME_hurt","SC"))) |>
  mutate(col = "alone")
full  <- rq1 |> filter(model == "full", term %in% term_order) |> mutate(col = "full")
inter <- rq1 |> filter(model == "full_MORxSC", term == "MOR:SC") |> mutate(col = "full")
t4 <- bind_rows(alone, full, inter) |>
  mutate(cell = ci(ratio, lo, hi), key = paste(outcome, col, sep = "_")) |>
  select(term, key, cell) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = key, values_from = cell) |>
  mutate(theory = factor(theory_of(term), levels = theory_levels), term = factor(term, levels = term_order)) |>
  arrange(theory, term) |>
  transmute(theory = as.character(theory), Measure = labv(as.character(term)),
            v_alone = off_vers_alone, v_full = off_vers_full, s_alone = serious_any_alone, s_full = serious_any_full)
t4[is.na(t4)] <- ""
p4 <- with_panels(t4, "theory")
nn <- \(y) n1$n_mi[n1$outcome == y]
ft4 <- flextable(p4$df) |>
  set_header_labels(v_alone = "Theory alone", v_full = "Full model", s_alone = "Theory alone", s_full = "Full model") |>
  add_header_row(values = c("", "Versatility, IRR [95% CI]", "Serious offending, OR [95% CI]"),
                 colwidths = c(1, 2, 2)) |>
  apa("Table A10. Associations of the theory measures with offending", panel_rows = p4$rows, width = 6.5,
      note = paste(paste0("n = ", nn("off_vers"), " (versatility) and ", nn("serious_any"), " (serious offending)."),
                   "Theory alone: the theory's measures with the controls only. Full model: all three theories and the controls.",
                   "Morality × self-control is from a separate model that adds the interaction to the full model.",
                   "Continuous predictors are per SD. All models include district socio-economic level and school type",
                   "and a random intercept for class. Estimates pooled over 50 imputations with Rubin's rules."))
add_tab("t4", ft4); ft4
```

## Appendix Table A11. Overlap of procedural justice and institutional anomie associations with the situational action measures (KHB)
```{r t5}
t5 <- khb |>
  mutate(term = factor(term, levels = term_order)) |> arrange(outcome, term) |>
  transmute(outcome = labv(outcome), Measure = labv(as.character(term)),
            Total = fmt(b_total, 3), Direct = fmt(b_direct, 3),
            Difference = ci(diff, diff_lo, diff_hi, 3),
            `% overlap` = ci(pct_overlap, pct_lo, pct_hi, 0),
            Morality = fmt(via_MOR, 3), `Shame: shoplifting` = fmt(via_SHAME_shop, 3),
            `Shame: hurting` = fmt(via_SHAME_hurt, 3), `Self-control` = fmt(via_SC, 3))
p5 <- with_panels(t5, "outcome")
ft5 <- flextable(p5$df) |>
  set_header_labels(Difference = "Difference [95% CI]", `% overlap` = "% overlap [95% CI]") |>
  add_header_row(values = c("", "Coefficient (log scale)", "", "Part of the difference shared with"),
                 colwidths = c(1, 3, 1, 4)) |>
  apa("Table A11. Overlap of the procedural justice and institutional anomie associations with the situational action measures",
      panel_rows = p5$rows, width = 9,
      note = paste("KHB decomposition (Karlson, Holm & Breen, 2012). Total: coefficient without the situational action",
                   "measures, on the scale of the full model. Direct: coefficient with them. Difference = total − direct.",
                   "Point estimates averaged over 50 imputations; 95% CIs from a class-level bootstrap (B = 1,000).",
                   "% overlap is not interpreted where the total coefficient is close to zero."))
add_tab("t5", ft5, landscape = TRUE); ft5
```

## Appendix Table A12. Property and violent offending (stacked model)
```{r t6}
type_order <- c("LEG","PJ","PJ_EQUAL","EFF","NTS_wth","NTS_cls","MOR","SHAME_shop","SHAME_hurt","SC",
                "male","deprfam","SCHB","PEERD")
t6 <- t_slope |>
  mutate(cell = ci(ratio, lo, hi)) |> select(mechanism, type, cell) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = type, values_from = cell) |>
  left_join(t_diff |> transmute(mechanism, diff = ci(ratio, lo, hi), p_diff = fp(p)), by = "mechanism") |>
  mutate(theory = factor(theory_of(mechanism), levels = theory_levels),
         mechanism = factor(mechanism, levels = type_order)) |>
  arrange(theory, mechanism) |>
  transmute(theory = as.character(theory), Measure = labv(as.character(mechanism)),
            Property = property, Violent = violent, Ratio = diff, p = p_diff)
p6 <- with_panels(t6, "theory")
ft6 <- flextable(p6$df) |>
  set_header_labels(Property = "Property, OR [95% CI]", Violent = "Violent, OR [95% CI]",
                    Ratio = "Ratio of ORs [95% CI]", p = "p (difference)") |>
  apa("Table A12. Associations with property and violent offending", panel_rows = p6$rows, width = 9,
      note = paste("Stacked logistic model with random intercepts for student and class; every measure listed may differ",
                   "between the two offence types. Ratio of ORs = violent OR / property OR; p tests whether the two ORs differ.",
                   "District socio-economic level and school type are shared across types. Per SD for continuous predictors.",
                   "Pooled over 50 imputations."))
add_tab("t6", ft6, landscape = TRUE); ft6
```

## Appendix Table A13. Differences between girls and boys (versatility)
```{r t7}
joint <- g_int |> filter(term == "all mechanism x sex")
gi <- g_int |> filter(term != "all mechanism x sex") |>
  mutate(mechanism = str_remove(term, ":male|male:"), p_bh = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"))
t7 <- gi |>
  left_join(g_ame |> mutate(cell = ci(est, lo, hi)) |> select(term, sex, cell) |>
              pivot_wider(names_from = sex, values_from = cell), by = c("mechanism" = "term")) |>
  mutate(theory = factor(theory_of(mechanism), levels = theory_levels),
         mechanism = factor(mechanism, levels = term_order)) |>
  arrange(theory, mechanism) |>
  transmute(theory = as.character(theory), Measure = labv(as.character(mechanism)),
            Interaction = ci(ratio, lo, hi), p = fp(p), p_bh = fp(p_bh), MDD = fmt(mdd),
            Girls = girls, Boys = boys)
p7 <- with_panels(t7, "theory")
ft7 <- flextable(p7$df) |>
  set_header_labels(Interaction = "IRR [95% CI]", p_bh = "p (BH)", MDD = "MDD",
                    Girls = "Girls", Boys = "Boys") |>
  add_header_row(values = c("", "Measure × male", "Average marginal effect [95% CI]"), colwidths = c(1, 4, 2)) |>
  apa("Table A13. Differences between girls and boys in the associations with versatility", panel_rows = p7$rows, width = 9,
      note = paste0("Negative binomial model of versatility with all measure × male interactions added to the full model. ",
                    "Joint test of the interactions: D2 = ", fmt(joint$D2), ", df = ", joint$df, ", p = ", fp(joint$p),
                    ", ΔAIC = ", fmt(joint$dAIC, 1), ". p (BH) = p adjusted for nine tests (Benjamini-Hochberg). ",
                    "MDD = smallest difference (log scale) detectable with 80% power at α = .05. ",
                    "Average marginal effect = change in the expected number of offence types per SD (per category for binary measures), ",
                    "random effects set to zero. Pooled over 50 imputations."))
add_tab("t7", ft7, landscape = TRUE); ft7
```

## Table 3 and Appendix Table A14. Correlates of legitimacy and indirect associations
```{r t8}
leg_order <- c("PJ", "EFF", "PJ_EQUAL", "male", "deprfam", "SCHB", "PEERD")
t8a <- bind_rows(
  leg |> filter(term %in% leg_order) |> mutate(term = factor(term, levels = leg_order)) |> arrange(term) |>
    transmute(Measure = labv(as.character(term)), b = fmt(b), SE = fmt(se), p = fp(p)),
  tibble(Measure = "Procedural fairness − perceived effectiveness",
         b = paste0(fmt(h3$est), " [", fmt(h3$lo), ", ", fmt(h3$hi), "]"), SE = fmt(h3$se), p = fp(h3$p)))
ft8a <- flextable(t8a) |>
  set_header_labels(b = "b") |>
  apa(paste0("Table 3. Correlates of legitimacy (n = ", leg$n[1], ")"),
      note = paste("Linear multilevel model; legitimacy and continuous predictors in SD units; equal treatment and male are binary.",
                   "The model includes district socio-economic level, school type and a random intercept for class.",
                   "The last row tests whether the fairness and effectiveness coefficients differ (95% CI in brackets)."))

t8b <- ind |>
  mutate(antecedent = factor(antecedent, levels = c("PJ", "EFF", "PJ_EQUAL"))) |> arrange(outcome, antecedent) |>
  transmute(outcome = labv(outcome), Measure = labv(as.character(antecedent)),
            a = fmt(a), b = fmt(b_leg, 3), Indirect = ci(indirect, ind_lo, ind_hi, 3), Direct = fmt(direct, 3))
p8 <- with_panels(t8b, "outcome")
ft8b <- flextable(p8$df) |>
  set_header_labels(a = "a", b = "b",
                    Indirect = "Indirect a × b [95% CI]", Direct = "Direct") |>
  apa("Table A14. Indirect associations with offending through legitimacy", panel_rows = p8$rows,
      note = paste("a = measure → legitimacy (SD units); b = legitimacy → offending.",
                   "b and the direct associations are on the log scale and come from models with the controls and the",
                   "procedural justice measures, without the situational action measures; the indirect associations are",
                   "therefore upper limits (see Table A11). 95% CIs from a class-level bootstrap (B = 1,000)."))
add_tab("t8a", ft8a); add_tab("t8b", ft8b); ft8a; ft8b
```

## Appendix Table A2. Robustness of the main associations
```{r a1}
alt <- c(LEG_nolaw = "LEG", NTS3_wth = "NTS_wth", NTS3_cls = "NTS_cls")   # substitute measures share a column
a1_terms <- c("SC", "SHAME_hurt", "MOR", "SHAME_shop", "LEG", "NTS_wth", "NTS_cls")
fam_of <- \(y) case_when(y %in% c("off_vers", "off_vers_upper") ~ "Versatility (IRR)",
                         y %in% c("serious_any", "serious_upper", "serious_freq") ~ "Serious offending (OR)",
                         TRUE ~ NA_character_)
check_lab <- c(`00` = "Main model", `01` = "Blank offence items counted as offences",
               `02` = "Non-disclosers excluded", `03a` = "Complete cases (reference)",
               `03b` = "Complete cases, screened-out cases re-included", `04` = "Without delinquent peers",
               `05` = "Survey-weighted, single level", `06` = "Serious offending: any serious offence 3+ times",
               `07` = "Norm and bond parts entered separately", `08` = "Legitimacy without lawfulness",
               `09` = "Over age for grade 9 added", `10` = "Grades 7–9 (no procedural justice measures)",
               `10b` = "Grades 7–8", `10c` = "Grade 9 (grades 7–9 sample rules)",
               `10d` = "Grades 7–9, with class mean × grade 9", `12` = "Three-informant norm transmission",
               `13` = "Peers' norms added", `14` = "Shame about arrest added", `15` = "Self-control subscales")
clean_check <- \(x) { code <- str_extract(x, "^\\d+[a-d]?"); unname(coalesce(check_lab[code], x)) }

a1 <- sens |>
  mutate(term = coalesce(alt[term], term), family = fam_of(outcome)) |>
  filter(!is.na(family), term %in% a1_terms) |>
  mutate(cell = paste0(fmt(ratio), " (", fp(p), ")"), order = check) |>
  select(family, order, check, term, cell) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = term, values_from = cell) |>
  arrange(desc(family), order) |>
  mutate(Check = clean_check(check)) |>
  select(family, Check, any_of(a1_terms))
names(a1)[-(1:2)] <- labv(names(a1)[-(1:2)])
pa1 <- with_panels(a1, "family")
fta1 <- flextable(pa1$df) |>
  apa("Table A2. Robustness of the main associations", panel_rows = pa1$rows, width = 9,
      note = paste("Cells: IRR or OR per SD (p). Imputed-data checks pool 50 imputations; complete-case and grades 7-9",
                   "checks use one dataset. Legitimacy without lawfulness and the three-informant norm transmission",
                   "measure are shown in the legitimacy and norm transmission columns. Empty cell: measure not in that model."))
add_tab("a1", fta1, landscape = TRUE); fta1
```

## Appendix Table A3. Additional terms and outcomes in the sensitivity checks
```{r a2}
a2 <- sens |>
  mutate(term = coalesce(alt[term], term), family = fam_of(outcome)) |>
  # main outcomes: only the extra terms; other outcomes (property, violent): every theory measure
  filter((!is.na(family) & !term %in% term_order & term %in% names(lab)) |
         (is.na(family) & term %in% term_order)) |>
  arrange(check, outcome, factor(term, levels = c(term_order, setdiff(names(lab), term_order)))) |>
  transmute(Check = clean_check(check), Outcome = labv(outcome), Measure = labv(term),
            `Ratio [95% CI]` = ci(ratio, lo, hi), p = fp(p))
fta2 <- flextable(a2) |>
  merge_v(j = c("Check", "Outcome")) |> valign(j = 1:2, valign = "top") |>
  apa("Table A3. Additional terms and outcomes in the sensitivity checks", width = 9,
      note = paste("Terms added in a sensitivity check (versatility and serious offending), and all theory measures for",
                   "property and violent offending where a check used these outcomes. IRR for versatility, OR for the binary",
                   "outcomes; per SD for continuous predictors. Procedural fairness, equal treatment and effectiveness",
                   "in every check are in sensitivity_v2.csv."))
add_tab("a2", fta2, landscape = TRUE); fta2
```

```{r a5}

  arrange(term) |> mutate(term = labv(as.character(term))) |> rename(Measure = term) |>
```

## Write all tables to Word
```{r write}
doc <- read_docx()
order <- c("t2a", "t2b", "t3", "t8a",                                    # main Tables 1-3
           "a0", "a1", "a2", "a3", "a4", "a5", "a6", "a7",               # Online Tables A1-A8
           "t1", "t4", "t5", "t6", "t7", "t8b")                          # Online Tables A9-A14
for (nm in intersect(order, names(tabs))) {
  t <- tabs[[nm]]
  doc <- body_add_flextable(doc, t$ft, align = "left")
  doc <- if (t$landscape) body_end_section_landscape(doc) else body_end_section_portrait(doc)
}
out <- here("output", "tables", "manuscript_tables.docx")
print(doc, target = out)
out
```

## Figures
Figure 1: each theory's measures with the controls only and in the full model (values of Table A10).
Figure 2: property and violent offending from the stacked model (values of Table A12).
Saved as PNG (300 dpi) and PDF in output/figures.
```{r figures, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5.2}
# Shared plotting functions for the manuscript figures (forest plots, ratio scale)
library(ggplot2)

col2  <- c("#2a78d6", "#eb6834")              # validated categorical slots 1-2
shp2  <- c(16, 17)                            # circle, triangle: second encoding for print/greyscale
theory_levels <- c("Procedural justice", "Institutional anomie", "Situational action")
theory_strip  <- c(`Procedural justice` = "Procedural\njustice", `Institutional anomie` = "Institutional\nanomie",
                   `Situational action` = "Situational\naction")

forest <- function(d, xlab, plabels = NULL, xbreaks = c(0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1, 1.25, 1.6, 2.5)) {
  # d: measure, theory, series, panel (optional), ratio, lo, hi
  d$measure <- factor(d$measure, levels = rev(unique(d$measure)))
  d$theory  <- factor(d$theory, levels = theory_levels)
  pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.6)
  g <- ggplot(d, aes(x = ratio, y = measure, colour = series, shape = series, group = forcats::fct_rev(series))) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1, colour = "grey45", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), height = 0, linewidth = 0.6, position = pd) +
    geom_point(size = 2.4, position = pd) +
    scale_x_log10(breaks = xbreaks, labels = function(x) format(x, nsmall = 1, trim = TRUE)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = col2, name = NULL) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = shp2, name = NULL) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10, base_family = "sans") +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
          strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 90, face = "bold"),
          strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"), strip.placement = "outside",
          legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left",
          axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "grey15"), plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 5))
  if ("panel" %in% names(d)) g <- g + facet_grid(theory ~ panel, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y", labeller = labeller(theory = theory_strip))
  else g <- g + facet_grid(theory ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y", labeller = labeller(theory = theory_strip))
  if (!is.null(plabels)) {
    plabels$measure <- factor(plabels$measure, levels = levels(d$measure))
    plabels$theory  <- factor(plabels$theory, levels = theory_levels)
    g <- g + geom_text(data = plabels, aes(x = xpos, y = measure, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
                       size = 3, colour = "grey20", hjust = 0) +
      coord_cartesian(clip = "off")
  }
  g
}

dir.create(here("output", "figures"), showWarnings = FALSE)
fig_terms <- c("LEG","PJ","PJ_EQUAL","EFF","NTS_wth","NTS_cls","MOR","SHAME_shop","SHAME_hurt","SC")

f1 <- bind_rows(alone |> mutate(series = "Theory with controls only"),
                full  |> mutate(series = "Full model")) |>
  filter(term %in% fig_terms) |>
  mutate(term = factor(term, levels = fig_terms)) |> arrange(term) |>
  transmute(measure = labv(as.character(term)), theory = theory_of(as.character(term)),
            series = factor(series, levels = c("Theory with controls only", "Full model")),
            panel = factor(ifelse(outcome == "off_vers", "Versatility (IRR)", "Serious offending (OR)"),
                           levels = c("Versatility (IRR)", "Serious offending (OR)")),
            ratio, lo, hi)
g1 <- forest(f1, "Rate ratio or odds ratio per SD (log scale)")
ggsave(here("output", "figures", "Figure1.png"), g1, width = 7, height = 5.2, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(here("output", "figures", "Figure1.pdf"), g1, width = 7, height = 5.2, bg = "white")
g1

f2 <- t_slope |> filter(mechanism %in% fig_terms) |>
  mutate(mechanism = factor(mechanism, levels = fig_terms)) |> arrange(mechanism) |>
  transmute(measure = labv(as.character(mechanism)), theory = theory_of(as.character(mechanism)),
            series = factor(ifelse(type == "property", "Property offending", "Violent offending"),
                            levels = c("Property offending", "Violent offending")),
            ratio, lo, hi)
x_p <- 1.15 * max(f2$hi)
pl <- t_diff |> filter(mechanism %in% fig_terms) |>
  transmute(measure = labv(mechanism), theory = theory_of(mechanism), xpos = x_p, label = paste("p =", fp(p)))
g2 <- forest(f2, "Odds ratio per SD (log scale)", plabels = pl) +
  geom_text(data = data.frame(theory = factor("Procedural justice", levels = theory_levels), x = x_p, y = Inf),
            aes(x = x, y = y, label = "Difference"), inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = -0.6, size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 60, 5, 5))
ggsave(here("output", "figures", "Figure2.png"), g2, width = 7, height = 4.6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(here("output", "figures", "Figure2.pdf"), g2, width = 7, height = 4.6, bg = "white")
g2
```
